HPC resources provided by LNCC. 79 80 12 APPENDIX A: GENIE ENVIRONMENT SETUP AND ARCHITECTURE To ensure a stable and reproducible simulation pipeline, the installation of the GENIE event generator requires a environment with several high-energy physics (HEP) and mathematical software packages. Since these are interconnected tools, the compilation must be performed using compatible versions. 12.1 SOFTWARE DEPENDENCIES The core execution and analysis capabilities of GENIE depend on the following primary software packages. CERN ROOT - Build with GSL and Mathmore (Version: 6.30.02): An object-oriented framework developed by CERN, optimized for big data processing, statistical analysis, data visualization, and hierarchical storage in high-energy physics [67]. GENIE relies on ROOT for its primary input/output operations and graphical analysis frameworks. Pythia (Version: 6.428): A standard Monte Carlo event generator utilized for simulating highenergy particle collisions, parton showers, and hadronization processes. Within the GENIE pipeline, Pythia is invoked to handle particle fragmentation and final-state decay processes [68]. GNU Scientific Library - GSL (Version: 2.7): A numerical library providing a wide range of mathematical routines in C++ [69]. GENIE utilizes GSL for critical numerical routines, including multi-dimensional integration algorithms, random number generation, and differential equation solvers required by various nuclear models.
